title: Solo project for a sci-fi hack n slash / rogue lite for mobile : does it look fun?
author: romvdss
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I’m a solo developer building that game, a 3D sci-fi hack n slash / roguelite for mobile and desktop. 

Claude Code handles a significant part of the coding and implementation, while I focus on game design, creative direction, gameplay mechanics, and constantly iterating on the results vs what I have in mind. 

Here’s a video of raw, unedited gameplay from my game.

I’m preparing the first beta release (Steam, iOS, Android) and would really appreciate your honest feedback on the visuals, combat, atmosphere, and overall feel watching that video, before anyone else gets their hands on it! 🙂

**-> Does this look like something you’d want to play? What would you improve based on that video ?**

Thanks a lot!

—

The story

On Mars, humanity discovered a mysterious resource known as Matter. Its discovery had an unforeseen consequence: a breach opened into the world of the Ancients, triggering a conflict between two civilizations.  
You play as a hero of the Ancients, fighting to reclaim your world.

The gameplay

Three modes: Until Death, survive endless waves of enemies; Extraction, retrieve an artifact and fight your way out; and Exploration, reclaim the Ancients’ sanctuaries region by region.

Earn XP, level up your hero, evolve your spells, collect increasingly rare items, and create powerful combinations of abilities.

Three semi-procedurally generated maps so far: Mars, a cyberpunk city, and the Ancients’ Forest.
